claims.evidence: No size text visible on sidewall or tread in the photo.
No brand markings visible; only platform watermark present.
Tread shows moderate wear with grooves and scuffing, but no measurement or fresh gauge shot to confirm percentage.
Inner sidewall and patch area not shown.
Full sidewall profile not clearly visible; only partial angle shown.
No DOT date code or vehicle documentation visible.

risks.risk: Actual tire size may not match 295/40R20
risks.proof: Clear close-up of sidewall showing size imprint
risks.if_unproven: priced as unknown/generic size, worst case mismatch risk

risks.proof: Full 360-degree sidewall video or multiple angle photos
risks.if_unproven: priced as possibly damaged, not full condition value

risks.proof: Photo with tread depth gauge or coin test
risks.if_unproven: priced as moderate wear per visible tread, not 90%

risks.proof: Clear photo of DOT code on sidewall
risks.if_unproven: priced as unknown age, assume older stock

risks.risk: Only one tire may be for sale, not a set
risks.proof: Photo showing all tires together with matching tread/brand

risks.risk: Possible patch or internal repair not visible externally
risks.proof: Photo of inner liner or seller receipt of repair history

proof_requests: Clear sidewall photo showing brand, size, and DOT date code
Full sidewall video (360°) showing both inner and outer faces
Tread depth measurement with gauge or coin in multiple spots
Photo confirming number of tires included in sale
Any purchase or removal documentation from the 2023 vehicle
response.reason: The witness confirms it is a used car tire, so it can be priced at worst case given unverified size, brand, tread, and condition claims.
